snippet.title: Powder Park: Ski Resort Builder – Official Trailer | From the creators of Ski Resort Tycoon
snippet.description:
Powder Park: Ski Resort Builder is a cozy ski town builder from The Cat's Eye Studio. Patrick Wilkinson, one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon, is back on the mountain with his son Maverick and a team that includes another Ski Resort Tycoon veteran. Twenty-five years later, this time you can ride it.

Shape the slopes, lay out lifts, lodges, jumps and rails, and build the town at the base. Then step off the drafting table and ski or snowboard every run you made, solo or with friends.

Grow your resort, tidy up your decorations, place a new lift, and watch visitors fill in the runs you've built. Visitors bring the resort to life, and you get to ride straight through it.

Every building, board and wipeout is modeled and animated by hand by someone on our team, a small studio building in the open. Powder Park puts a cozy spin on the tycoon sandbox: it's 100% pressure free. Every budget sheet, chore or bump in the road you'd find in a real business, we chose to buff down into a smooth, relaxing experience. Instead of stressing, you turn a mountain into a home.

Play on Steam: https://www.powderparkgame.com/steam?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=trailer
Our story, from Ski Resort Tycoon to Powder Park: https://www.powderparkgame.com/ski-resort-tycoon
Website: https://www.powderparkgame.com
